name: qkd_hr_ingest_eng_sp7b-sp7b-COMMIT
purpose: sp6a/sp6b gate GRT congestion (sp6a 388.8x561.6 total overflow 139,692; sp6b 475.2x518.4 3,915 at 23% usage) is local: hot gcells x 150-300 / y 175-350 = the 75.6x43.2 macro lattice channels; each 32x128 SRAM has ~270 M4 pins on its 20.8-um W edge (macro OBS M1-M4), so std cells + M4 escapes crowd 24-um channels. sp7b: same source/pins/clocks, macros re-pitched: 4 columns pitch 118.8 um (67.4 um channel), 8 rows pitch 64.8 um (44 um row gap); outline 626.4x583.2 (enlarge, owner 10-21). sp6 CTS spread/timing (+91/+107 ps) were fine.
